defects.before: bwx runners: the sum over the threads of bytes / elapsed time.

defects.evidence: build_facts.py check `I-agg` takes `dmax(x)` over `X` only (parts L, C and control I), and check 14 in FACTS.md lists exactly the 9 tags T72L1 to T72I2, so the 8000 MT/s baseline files are not in this check.
